title: decicontas.br: a Named Entity Recognition dataset of Brazilian audit-court decisions
description:
A public Named Entity Recognition dataset of 861 decisions issued by the Tribunal de Contas do Estado do Rio Grande do Norte (TCE/RN), annotated with four audit-relevant entity types: MULTA (fines), OBRIGACAO (binding obligations), RESSARCIMENTO (reimbursements to the public treasury) and RECOMENDACAO (non-binding recommendations).

The corpus ships with an explicit quality protocol: a confident-learning audit of annotation errors, released in paired pre- and post-review versions, and an independent three-annotator agreement study (token-level Fleiss kappa = 0.865; pairwise span F1 between 0.776 and 0.838). Release bundles are provided in JSON, JSONL, CoNLL-2003 and BRAT formats with SHA-256 checksums, together with the evaluation and training pipelines that reproduce the reported results.

Companion artefact to the dissertation Reconhecimento de Entidades Nomeadas em Decisões do TCE/RN (Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Norte).
